tagline: The old US 93 over Rough Summit to the dam.
intro: SR 172 leaves I-11 northeast of Boulder City and turns onto the old Nevada Highway, the original line of US 93, curving along the mountainside over Rough Summit. Just past the turnoff for the Lakeview viewpoint the state route ends at a security checkpoint on the edge of the Hoover Dam Reservation, and so does the road mapped here, about a mile and a half in all. Beyond the checkpoint the access road goes on past the bridge plaza and the visitor center, across the top of the dam into Arizona, and loops back.
Until October 2010 this was US 93 itself, with all its through traffic riding the crest of the dam. The bypass took that away, and several hairpin turns and blind curves with it.

moments.title: Mike O'Callaghan-Pat Tillman Memorial Bridge
moments.text: Opened in 2010 some 1,500 feet downstream, the bypass bridge arches 890 feet over the Colorado, named for a Nevada governor and for Pat Tillman, the football player killed in Afghanistan.

moments.title: Hoover Dam
moments.text: The road crosses the crest of the concrete arch handed over in 1936, more than two years early, after a dedication at which Roosevelt never said Hoover's name.

practical: Through traffic no longer crosses the dam. Visitors approach from the Nevada side through a security checkpoint, and not all vehicles are allowed to cross.
